tools.title: DC current & power
tools.description: Enter voltage and resistance to find current and power.
tools.formula: I = V ÷ R; P = V × I

tools.title: Two resistors · series / parallel
tools.description: Quick nominal resistance for two components.
tools.formula: Series: R1 + R2. Parallel: (R1 × R2) ÷ (R1 + R2)

tools.title: CCTV storage estimate
tools.description: Turn average video bitrate and recording time into decimal GB / TB.

tools.title: Camera link bandwidth
tools.description: Add streams that actually cross the network link.
tools.formula: Payload Mbit/s = cameras × bitrate × streams per camera

fields.label: Streams per camera crossing this link

tools.title: PoE budget check
tools.description: Check total switch allocation and individual port headroom.
tools.formula: Total allocation = devices × allocated watts per device

fields.label: Maximum allocation at switch per device (W)

tools.title: DC load total
tools.description: Add identical low-voltage loads in mA and calculate steady power.
tools.formula: A = devices × mA ÷ 1000; W = V × A

guides.title: Ohm’s law at a glance
guides.alt: Voltage above current and resistance in a triangle, with V equals I times R; I equals V divided by R; R equals V divided by I.
notes: For resistive DC arithmetic. This is not an instruction to measure resistance on a live circuit.

guides.title: Series / parallel picture guide
guides.alt: Two resistors on one path add in series. Two resistors on separate branches use product divided by sum.
notes: Original abstract circuit. Do not infer an intruder detector’s EOL/DEOL wiring profile from this picture; use its panel and detector documentation.

guides.title: PSU reading or device reading?
guides.alt: Two conductors link a DC supply and a device. Point A is across the supply terminals. Point B is across device terminals. Record operating condition separately.
notes: A record-keeping concept for low-voltage DC equipment, not a live-work procedure. Only measure at points accessible under the equipment’s documented procedure. Record exact points, polarity, load, and connected or isolated state.

guides.title: Camera, switch or recorder?
guides.alt: Camera connects to switch then recorder, with power, port, uplink and storage listed as separate observations.
notes: Use the actual network topology. Recorder reachability does not establish camera power or uplink health. This guide suggests where observations belong; it does not diagnose a failed part.

guides.title: PoE total versus port limit
guides.alt: The switch total budget sits above three ports, each with its own port limit and device demand.
notes: Check both limits and the documented IEEE type/class and negotiation. Use switch-side maximum allocation; a device power figure alone may exclude cable loss and allocation overhead.

guides.title: Relay click ≠ door open
guides.alt: Relay coil and contacts are separate. A changeover contact connects COM to NC with the coil de-energised; NO is open.
notes: Generic electromagnetic relay, coil de-energised. Actual equipment can use other relay/contact arrangements. NC/NO names do not establish a lock’s fail-safe/fail-secure operation or permission to interrupt escape functions.
